name: mirage
text: Short answer: in theory yes (independent +EV legs multiply into a +EV parlay), in practice not on Novig through this app. Two blockers: (1) Novig's API does not offer parlays/RFQs to us (NOVIG_API.md: parlay pricing is LP-only, needs a ~$30,000 deposit), so the engine could only place single legs; (2) maths: a parlay's EV is roughly the product of the legs' (1+EV), so edges add up (3 legs at +4% is ~+12%) but so does variance and the error in each fair-odds estimate, and parlay pricing usually carries extra margin that eats it. Doing it by hand in Novig's own app is possible; I can build a tracker that lists same-day +EV legs from different games to combine, but I would not expect it to beat the single bets the engine already places at the same edge. Say the word if you want that.
